react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-enrichment paradigms (RaMP multi-DB ORA, MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA, and mummichog m/z-direct activity) converge on Galactose Metabolism as the dominant affected pathway. In the RaMP ORA, the five input carbohydrates (galactinol, sucrose, myo-inositol, galactitol, glycerol) produce an FDR of 1.22e-15 with a fold-enrichment of 1801 against SMPDB:SMP00182 "Galactosemia" and SMPDB:SMP00043 "Galactose Metabolism"; the same five compounds replicate this signal in the KEGG-namespace MetaboAnalystR PSEA (p = 9.53e-10, KEGG:hsa00052) and in the mummichog empirical network (p = 5.88e-4, MUMM:galactose_metabolism, overlap 10/11 compounds). The consensus driver set is galactinol (KEGG:C01235), sucrose (KEGG:C00089), and galactitol (KEGG:C01697) acting through the Leloir pathway, with myo-inositol (KEGG:C00137) and glycerol (KEGG:C00116) as branch intermediaries. A secondary cross-paradigm signal appears in glycerophospholipid metabolism: Reactome R-HSA-1483206 (FDR 3.6e-4) and mummichog MUMM:glycerophospholipid_metabolism (p = 0.0024) both hit on myo-inositol and glycerol, consistent with inositol's role as a phosphatidylinositol head-group precursor and glycerol's backbone position. Acetylcholine (KEGG:C01996) only reaches the MUMM:glycerophospholipid_metabolism set via its choline moiety, whereas 2,3-epoxyaflatoxin B1 (KEGG:C19586) remains below significance thresholds in all paradigms. The Galactose Metabolism consensus is the primary biological story.

final_react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary pathway-enrichment paradigms (RaMP multi-DB ORA, MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA, and mummichog m/z-direct activity) converge on Galactose Metabolism as the dominant affected pathway. In the RaMP ORA, the five input carbohydrates (galactinol, sucrose, myo-inositol, galactitol, glycerol) produce an FDR of 1.22e-15 with a fold-enrichment of 1801 against SMPDB:SMP00182 "Galactosemia" and SMPDB:SMP00043 "Galactose Metabolism"; the same five compounds replicate this signal in the KEGG-namespace MetaboAnalystR PSEA (p = 9.53e-10, KEGG:hsa00052) and in the mummichog empirical network (p = 5.88e-4, MUMM:galactose_metabolism, overlap 10/11 compounds). The consensus driver set is galactinol (KEGG:C01235), sucrose (KEGG:C00089), and galactitol (KEGG:C01697) acting through the Leloir pathway, with myo-inositol (KEGG:C00137) and glycerol (KEGG:C00116) as branch intermediaries. A secondary cross-paradigm signal appears in glycerophospholipid metabolism: Reactome R-HSA-1483206 (FDR 3.6e-4) and mummichog MUMM:glycerophospholipid_metabolism (p = 0.0024) both hit on myo-inositol and glycerol, consistent with inositol's role as a phosphatidylinositol head-group precursor and glycerol's backbone position. Acetylcholine (KEGG:C01996) only reaches the MUMM:glycerophospholipid_metabolism set via its choline moiety, whereas 2,3-epoxyaflatoxin B1 (KEGG:C19586) remains below significance thresholds in all paradigms. The Galactose Metabolism consensus is the primary biological story.
